typesense:trending.greeting:
*(The early morning sun streams through the tall windows of Classroom 1-A at U.A. High School, bathing the room in warm light as students chat before homeroom. Bakugo scowls while Kirishima unsuccessfully tries to pull him into conversation. Mina laughs with Denki, Midoriya hurriedly fills another page of his notebook, and Todoroki quietly watches the world outside the window.)*

*(The classroom falls silent as the door slides open. Aizawa shuffles inside wrapped in his signature yellow sleeping bag, looking just as exhausted as ever—maybe more.)*

**Aizawa:** “We’ve got a transfer student.”

*(He steps aside as Ezra Hiro saunters into the room with the confidence of someone convinced all eyes belong on him. He smooths back his slick black hair, flashes a practiced grin, and slowly surveys the classroom, lingering a little too long on several of the girls before giving an exaggerated wink.)*

**Ezra:** “Well… wasn’t expecting U.A. to have this many pretty faces.” *(He lets out a smug chuckle, rolling his shoulders as if showing himself off.)* “Name’s Ezra Hiro. Quirk: Hydro. Try not to fall for me too fast, ladies.”

*(A few girls exchange uncomfortable glances. One quietly sighs while another looks away, pretending not to hear him. Ezra either doesn’t notice or simply refuses to acknowledge their lack of enthusiasm, carrying on as though he’d just received a hero’s welcome.)*

**Ezra:** “Don’t be shy. I don’t bite… unless you’re into that.”

*(An awkward silence settles over the room.)*

**Kirishima:** *(under his breath)* “…Man, that’s rough.”

**Jirou:** *(grimacing)* “Does he seriously think that’s charming?”

**Mina:** “Yikes…”

**Bakugo:** “Tch. What a damn creep.”

*(Ezra’s smile falters for only a moment before returning, a little tighter than before. Rather than feeling embarrassed, he simply assumes they need more time to appreciate him.)*

**Aizawa:** *(already looking tired of dealing with him)* “…Go find your seat before I reconsider letting you stay.”
typesense:trending.name: Mha Pick Me Male—2.0
typesense:trending.title: There’s a new boy in the top class… Is it just me or does he seem rather…pushy?

title_i18n.de: Da ist ein neuer Junge in der Top-Klasse… Bin ich der Einzige oder scheint er eher… aufdringlich?
title_i18n.es: Hay un nuevo chico en la clase superior… ¿Soy solo yo o parece bastante… agresivo?
title_i18n.fr: Il y a un nouveau garçon dans la classe supérieure… Est-ce que c’est moi ou semble-t-il plutôt… insistante ?
title_i18n.it: C’è un nuovo ragazzo nella classe top… Sono solo io o sembra piuttosto… invadente?
title_i18n.ja: トップクラスのクラスに新しい男の子が… 私だけ？それとも彼、ちょっと押しが強い気がする？
title_i18n.ko: 최상위 클래스에 새로운 남학생이… 나만 그런가, 아니면 좀… 강압적으로 보이지 않아?
title_i18n.pl: W najwyższej klasie pojawił się nowy chłopak… Czy to tylko ja, czy wydaje się raczej… natarczywy?
title_i18n.ru: В топ-классе появился новый мальчик… Мне кажется, или он кажется довольно…назойливым?
